- [IRET.1.6] **Token as flat array of fact pointers.**
  A partial match (token) is an array of `ds_rete_fact_t *`
  with one entry per pattern in the rule, in
  pattern-declaration order. Variable bindings are
  implicit: to read binding `s` in pattern position `i`,
  slot `j`, evaluate `token->facts[i]->slots[j]`.
  Tokens carry a `creation_timetag` — a stamp monotone in
  completion order, assigned when the token is completed and
  ordered as [LDET.5.5] defines — for agenda ordering.
